question: What fraction of the position is closed at each take-profit level, and at which level is the stop moved to break even?
whyItMatters: CLAIM|TJR|20260727|030 states that profits are taken in partials across multiple take-profit levels and the remainder is left to stop out at break even, but specifies neither the partial sizes nor the trigger for moving the stop. Without both, realised R per trade is not reconstructible from the rules, so the strategy's own reported results (CLAIM|TJR|20260727|044-046) cannot be reproduced or checked.
